name: Retry Death Spiral
description: Payment dependency degrades, checkout retries amplify into a death spiral, latency spikes across the checkout path.

commonAnnotations.summary: Retry pressure above baseline — checkout retry rate exceeds 0.25 threshold with payment service degraded.

traces: retry fan-out visible across checkout service

candidate_actions.description: Shift traffic to the secondary region

restart_payment.notes: Restarting refreshes pods, but the retry loop keeps pressure on payment.

disable_flag.notes: Feature disable sheds the degraded dependency path quickly, but disables payment capability entirely.

rate_limit_retries.notes: Retry shaping stabilizes the system while keeping the product mostly available.

shift_traffic.notes: Traffic shifting spreads load but does not fix the core degraded dependency.

ground_truth.why: Rate limiting directly addresses the retry amplification root cause with minimal blast radius.

naive_reflex.why: A tired engineer restarts what looks broken, but restarting does not stop the retry amplification loop.

evaluation_labels.reflex_rejected_reason: Restarting payment pods does not stop the retry amplification loop. The retries continue hammering the recovering service, causing re-degradation within minutes. The system remains in a degraded oscillation.
evaluation_labels.fairness_impact: Rate limiting preserves payment availability for legitimate requests while shedding excess retry load from the amplification loop.
